info.title: Inboundfy
info.summary: Inbound marketing framework with AI skills: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to install the framework and manage the archive, channels and editorial calendar.
info.description: Inbound marketing framework with AI skills: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to install the framework and manage the archive, channels and editorial calendar. Without arguments it opens the TUI; "inboundfy mcp" starts the MCP server over stdio; any other command runs as a CLI with text or --json output.

options.description: Return JSON output with the envelope { ok, command, data } or { ok, command, error }. Errors are JSON too.
